name: Guide
title: Direction Signs
description: A helpful figure maintaining the Tower's directional signs, ensuring climbers know the way up.
greeting_variants: *painting sign* Top: 47 floors. Stairs that way. Lift here.
Guide. I point. You climb. Simple arrangement.
New climber? Read all signs. Twice. Save your life.
Ward taught me. Capital. Good man. Clear signs. Important.
*repainting* Faded again. Tower does that. Eats clarity.
Top floor: Palace access. If you make it. Most don't.
Follow arrows. Don't improvise. Tower punishes explorers.

dialog_tree.text: Guide. Sign maintainer. Ward—Capital, you know him?—taught me. 'Clear warnings save lives.' Tower needs warnings. Needs directions. Too easy to get lost. Lost means... *shivers* ...means gone.

Forty-seven floors. Each different. Some safe—commissary, observation. Some... not. The Tower changes as you climb. Tests you. Echoes of old times. Echoes of... possibilities. Don't trust everything you see.

options.text: What do you mean by echoes?

dialog_tree.text: *serious* Floor 20: Ventilation fans. Don't touch. Floor 28: Mirror maze. Don't trust reflections. Floor 35: Gravity shifts. Watch your step. Floor 40: End of lift. Stairs only. Harder from there.
*warm smile* Good man. Saved my life once. Wrong turn in ruins. His sign warned me. Taught me everything. 'Clarity,' he said. 'In confusion, clarity saves.' I try to honor that. Even here.

mini_quest.title: The Climb - Clear the Path
mini_quest.description: Help Guide restore and replace signs throughout the Tower to ensure safe passage for all climbers.
objectives: Gather sign-making materials from the supply room
Add warning markers at Floor 28's mirror maze
Install new directional signs at Floor 35 junction

ambient_barks: Arrow points up. Always up. Until top.
Floor 12 this way. Food there. Steel cooks.
Read the signs. Trust the signs. Ignore... distractions.
Ward would like this one. Clean. Simple.
*to climber* You look tired. Floor 12. Rest. Then climb.

cross_zone_references.capital: Ward's there. Signs everywhere. Keeping people safe.
cross_zone_references.void: Signs don't hold there. Too... shifting. Ward suffers.
cross_zone_references.palace: Top. End. Beginning. Signs end there. Everything ends there.

kael.greeting: Your signs are clear. Well done.

world_state_triggers.sign_faded: Urgent: 'Fading! Must repaint! People will get lost!'
world_state_triggers.new_floor_appears: Confused: 'New floor? No sign for... must make sign. Fast.'
